poc_plan:
Objectives: validate Dedicated latency SLOs, verify canary routing + rollback, confirm model-variant fallbacks, test region failover for US->EU.
Success criteria: stable p99 < 120ms at 50 concurrent sessions, automated rollback works, no data exfiltration issues in security scan.
Phases: 1) Baseline Hosted (week 0) — latency/cost baseline. 2) Dedicated canary (weeks 1-2) — route 5-10% traffic to Dedicated pool, measure metrics. 3) Ramp & fallback (week 3) — stress test, enable model variant fallback and region failover. 4) Hand-off + runbook (week 4) — rollback/playbook, SLO dashboard, pricing sign-off.
technical_requirements_summary: Latency p99 target <120ms for chat assist; throughput ~200 reqs/sec peak for US region; embedding generation for search reranks batched; must support model variants (gpt-like large / gpt-like quantized) and automatic fallback; KV cache persistence across short sessions desirable; SSO + KMS for keys; logs and audit trail retention 1 year.
pricing_sensitivity: High — customer expects dedicated pricing within 20-30% of hosted cost per token via reserved commits + predictable burst plan. Wants examples of unit economics for their workload (batching, cache impact).
decision_criteria: 1) Demonstrated p99 latency & stability during canary. 2) Clear rollback and routing controls in Console. 3) Security sign-off (SOC2 + KMS). 4) Predictable pricing and committed capacity options.
recent_demo_feedback: Liked the Canary UI and traffic-splitting demo; asked for clearer logs showing per-model failure reasons. Asked for a short runbook for rollback and an automated test to validate fallback behavior.
risk_assessment: Medium. Execution risk: SE team needs to prove fallback works under real error modes (GPU OOM, model crash). Commercial risk: finance wants tighter ARR band. Security risk: EU customers require residency verification — may need dedicated EU pool or routing policy.
next_steps_internal: Schedule Dedicated POC kickoff 2026-02-15; SE to prepare infra checklist and IAM roles; pricing to produce 3-tier committed capacity proposal by 2026-02-20.
